messages:
noah-csm: Quick heads-up 10: we surfaced ~70 tenants with delayed onboard embeddings after last night's rollout. ~12 are within 30 days of renewal. Proposing: short remediation office hours, a tiny diagnostic customers can paste, and a small, tailored credit for those with renewal risk. Thoughts?

fiona-cs: Agree. Keep customer comms super short and calm. Lead with 'No action required if search behaves normally.' Offer a 30m remediation slot and a recorded replay. Also request permission to proactively schedule 1:1s for <30d renewals.

kevin-eng: Root cause: race in background backfill during scaled deploy. Mitigation applied; queue now rate-limited and replayed safely. No evidence of vector deletion. Recommend we tell customers NOT to re-run full reindex. I'll provide a one-line diagnostic for customers.

lina-ops: Ops can host remediation slots next week 08:30 PT and 11:30 PT (30m), and will auto-open a ticket when a customer requests a 1:1. I'll add a localized calendar link for EU and APAC as well.

noah-csm (draft message): ```Hi <Customer>,
We identified a temporary onboarding delay that may have impacted embeddings for a subset of tenants. Engineers have mitigated the issue; we have not observed data loss.
If your search results look normal, no action is needed. If you notice missing results, schedule a 30-minute remediation slot here: https://cal.redwood.ai/remediate
We are also offering a small goodwill credit for customers in renewal windows.
Thanks, Noah (Customer Success)```

fiona-cs: Nice. Add FAQ line: 'Data retention unaffected; reindex only if support recommends.' And include the diagnostic snippet.

kevin-eng: Diagnostic (paste into terminal or Console): `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/<index>/stats | jq .vector_count`

lina-ops: Action items: 1) noah finalize email + calendar link by EOD; 2) fiona prepare localized short copy for ES/FR/DE; 3) kevin to confirm diagnostic endpoint and public wording by 20:00 PT; 4) ops to tag and proactively outreach <30d renewals. I'll set up auto-ticketing (INC-ONBOARD-2987).

audit-bot: Incident ticket INC-ONBOARD-2987 created and assigned to customer-success.

fiona-cs: We'll capture quick feedback after each session with 2 questions: (1) Did this resolve your issue? yes/no (2) Any follow-up request? free text. Keep it short for response rate.

noah-csm: Plan to send first wave to <30d cohort 09:00 PT tomorrow and monitor replies for urgent escalations. If anything blocks timeline flag here.

kevin-eng: I'll sign off on public wording tonight.

lina-ops: Calendar links created: https://cal.redwood.ai/remediate (PT slots) and https://cal.redwood.ai/remediate-eu (CET slots).

fiona-cs: Great work team. We'll prioritize top 12 renewal accounts for proactive 1:1 outreach and propose credit amounts in the follow-up thread.

noah-csm: Thanks all 10. Closing this thread; will post postmortem + credit bands after first wave.
